>
> We recognize that this change may cause disappointment and inconvenience. Please direct any questions to the church leadership.

If the decision is actually pending a conversation with him, use **“has been postponed pending review”** instead of “has been canceled.”

Leave the pantheism allegation—and Sterling’s pledge—off the public notice. Before issuing any doctrinal condemnation, get the specific words in context and give Tariq a chance to respond.

The deadline is real, but **registration, housing, and a permanent-expulsion promise are three separate decisions.** You can stop registration now without treating the elders’ report as established fact.

A residency-revocation letter may not constitute a lawful eviction; that depends on the jurisdiction, residency agreement, and required process. Nor can I assure you that a permanent-expulsion guarantee would be enforceable or within your authority. **Don’t issue either as binding without legal review.**

Here are two immediate alternatives—not an eviction notice or an expulsion guarantee.

### 1. To Mir: program suspension; residency unchanged

**Subject: Immediate suspension of scheduled teaching**

Dear Mir,

Effective immediately, [Organization] is suspending your scheduled teaching series and pausing registration.

Leadership has received concerns about statements attributed to you. We have not yet verified the statements or obtained your response. This suspension is an interim administrative measure, not a finding of misconduct or a doctrinal determination.

Please contact [name/contact] by [reasonable date and time] so that we can provide the specific concerns and arrange an opportunity for you to respond.

This letter does not terminate your residency or require you to vacate. Any proposed change to your residency will be addressed separately under the applicable agreement and law.

Sincerely,  
[Authorized signatory]

### 2. To Sterling: confirmation of immediate action, without a permanent guarantee

**Subject: Teaching series and pledge documentation**

Dear Sterling,

We confirm that [Organization] has suspended the teaching series involving [full name] and paused registration, effective immediately.

This action does not constitute a finding regarding the statements attributed to the speaker. We cannot guarantee permanent expulsion or termination of residency before establishing the facts and completing the applicable governance and legal processes.

Please ensure that any pledge or release documents accurately reflect this limited action. We are not accepting a permanent-expulsion condition through this letter.

Sincerely,  
[Authorized signatory]

**Before sending:** confirm whether Mir and Tariq are the same person, use the correct full name, and verify the signer’s authority. Don’t lock anyone out or remove their belongings on the strength of these letters.
